title: Global case: a measure finite on compacts with unit-multiplicity tangent planes on a carrying measurable S equals Hⁿ⌞S, and S is rectifiable (parent Steps 3–8 with U = ℝ^{n+ℓ})
statement: Assume (RT) [the frozen type of root.rectifiable_of_tangent_measure-a1]: for all n, ℓ ∈ ℕ and every Borel measure λ on ℝ^{n+ℓ} with λ(K) < ∞ for every compact K such that, for λ-a.e. y, there are a subspace P and θ > 0 with HasApproxTangentPlaneWithMultiplicity n λ y P θ, there is a measurable, countably n-rectifiable R ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} with λ(ℝ^{n+ℓ} ∖ R) = 0. Assume also (AT) ApproximateTangentCharacterization (Simon Ch. 3, Theorem 1.6). Then for all n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, every measurable S ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ}, and every Borel measure μ on ℝ^{n+ℓ} with μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K and μ(ℝ^{n+ℓ} ∖ S) = 0 such that every x ∈ S has a subspace P with HasApproxTangentPlaneWithMultiplicity n μ x P 1: S is countably n-rectifiable and μ = Hⁿ⌞S (μ = μHE[n].restrict S).
lean_statement: (∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Rn (n + ℓ))), (∀ K : Set (Rn (n + ℓ)), IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∃ (P : Submodule ℝ (Rn (n + ℓ))) (θ : ℝ), 0 < θ ∧ HasApproxTangentPlaneWithMultiplicity n μ x P θ) → ∃ R : Set (Rn (n + ℓ)), MeasurableSet R ∧ CountablyRectifiable n R ∧ μ Rᶜ = 0) → ApproximateTangentCharacterization → ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (S : Set (Rn (n + ℓ))) (μ : Measure (Rn (n + ℓ))), (∀ K : Set (Rn (n + ℓ)), IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) → MeasurableSet S → μ Sᶜ = 0 → (∀ x ∈ S, ∃ P : Submodule ℝ (Rn (n + ℓ)), HasApproxTangentPlaneWithMultiplicity n μ x P 1) → CountablyRectifiable n S ∧ μ = (μHE[n] : Measure (Rn (n + ℓ))).restrict S
